teleportblock.configuration.title: Teleport Block Settings
teleportblock.configuration.singleplayer: Settings for your own worlds, including worlds opened to LAN.
You are playing on a server - the server's settings apply.
teleportblock.configuration.server.toolt: Set by the server administrator in config/teleportblock-server.toml on the server.
teleportblock.configuration.server.onlin: The settings of this server apply. Only its administrator can change them.
teleportblock.configuration.cooldown_sec: Delay between teleports through the same pair of blocks.
teleportblock.configuration.pearl_cooldo: Delay between ender pearl teleports through the same pair of blocks.
teleportblock.configuration.max_link_dis: Maximum distance between two linked blocks.
teleportblock.configuration.check_distan: Also apply the max link distance on each teleport, not only when linking. Useful for blocks on Create: Aeronautics ships.
teleportblock.configuration.xp_per_100_b: Experience points (not levels) charged for every 100 blocks of straight-line distance. 0 = free. Creative mode is always free.
Upper limit for one teleport, in experience points. 0 = no limit.
teleportblock.configuration.owner_only.t: Only the player who linked a pair, or a server operator, can re-link, rename or switch its mode. Everyone can still teleport.
teleportblock.configuration.cross_dimens: Allow linking blocks in different dimensions. Distance uses Overworld-scale coordinates (the Nether counts x8, like vanilla portals). Existing links are kept while this is off.
teleportblock.configuration.dimension_bl: Dimensions that cannot be linked to or from another dimension, e.g. minecraft:the_end. Links inside such a dimension still work.
teleportblock.configuration.cross_dimens: Extra experience points charged for a teleport between dimensions, on top of the distance cost. 0 = no extra cost.
